title: Implement a declared module contract
prompt: The declaration promises groups_needed(items, capacity). Return -1 for negative items or nonpositive capacity. Otherwise count groups of size capacity, rounding upward. Avoid an addition that might overflow int. Inputs fit in int.

tests.label: Remainder needs another group
tests.hint: A nonzero remainder needs one extra group.

tests.label: Exact fit
tests.hint: Do not add one when there is no remainder.

hints: An int declaration gives the caller the signature; the definition supplies the body.
Use quotient plus (remainder != 0) after checking capacity.
explanation: A multi-file build compiles declarations and definitions in separate translation units, then links them. This single-file lab exercises the same signature and behavior; the book’s original project teaches the physical file split.
